card.name: Linking words before harm or risk terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (to, from, and, comma) that come just before a named cause of death, complication or serious adverse effect. Also heading words in warnings sections.

modes.label: Cause of death or harm
modes.description: A word like to or from after deaths or dies, leading into a complication or cause.

modes.description: The first words of a warning heading about a serious reaction.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about safety and harm, such as unsafe, and away from words about pain and suffering.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before the text names a serious harm, such as a cause of death or a dangerous side effect.
